question: The Ajanta Caves are located on the left bank of which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Waghora**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ajanta Caves were carved out of a horse-shoe-shaped rock on the banks of the Waghorn River in the 2nd century BC.
 
• The **Ajanta caves **were discovered in 1819.
 
• The **Ajanta Caves **are a series of 29 Buddhist cave temples in Ajanta, India, some of which date back to the **2nd century BC**.
 
• The **Ajanta Caves** preserve some of the best works of **Buddhist **art in India.
 
• **25 caves** were used as viharas or residential caves while **4 were** used as chaityas or prayer halls.
 
• The caves were developed in the period between **200 BC to 650 AD**.
 
• The **Ajanta Caves** were carved by **Buddhist **monks under the patronage of the** Vakataka kings.**
 
• The figures in these caves were done using **fresco painting**.
 
• These caves were declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Waghora River__

 __
 
• ​__The Waghora River **is a river in the state of Maharashtra, India, that flows along the western ghats**
 
• The Waghora River is located in the Aurangabad district of Maharashtra, near the Ajanta Caves
 
• **Waghora Waterfalls**
 
 
• **​**The Waghora Waterfalls are located in the Jalgaon district of Maharashtra, near the Ajanta Caves.
 
• The waterfalls cascade down the cliffs surrounding the caves.
